title: Spatial multi-omics reveals a regulatory role of subepithelial fibroblasts in the human airway

materials_reviewed.notes: Full text parsed from PDF and review_md. Airway subepithelial fibroblasts and peripheral nerve cell types reviewed.
Single cell and nuclei dissociation, 10x Genomics, Visium spatial transcriptomics, and antibody staining protocols reviewed.
Fig. 1 (atlas overview), Fig. 2 (fibroblasts & peripheral nerve spatial mapping), Fig. 3 (endothelial & smooth muscle), Fig. 4-5 (SMG and immune niche) reviewed.
Extended Data Fig. 4 (PB-fibro, PC-fibro), Extended Data Fig. 5 (Schwann cells and NAFs), Extended Data Fig. 6-7 (SMG and stroma), Extended Data Fig. 10 (PRR4/serous staining) reviewed.
